div.head: V Atr 9.2
div.ab: ⁊ se þe þæt nelle þæt his hade gebyrige: wanige his weorðscype ge for Gode ge for worolde.
⁊ se ðe þæt nelle þæt his hade gebyrige: wanige his weorðscype ge for Gode ge for worolde.
⁊ se þe þæt nelle: wanige his wurðscipe ge for Gode ge for worlde.
⁊ se þe þæt nelle, [þæt his hade gebyrige], wanige his wurðscipe ge for Gode ge for worlde.
And se þe þæt nelle þæt his hade gebyrige wanige his weorðscype ge for Gode ge for worolde.
Dagegen wer das ablehnt, was seinem geweihten Stande ziemt: schwinde sein Ehrenrang so bei der Kirche wie im Weltlichen.
But whoever refuses what befits his [holy] order: let his honour diminish both before God and before the world.
And he who will not do [what befits his order] shall impair both his ecclesiastical and his civil status.
And he who will not do what belongs to his order, may his dignity be diminished both in religious and secular concerns.
But he who will not act in a manner fitting for his order shall diminish his honor before God and the world.
